How to Donate

We're launching online donations this month. In the meantime, you can donate by check or contact us to arrange your contribution.

Donate by Check

Available Now

Mail a check to support portfolio grants for emerging creative talent. Your donation is secure, tax-deductible once our 501(c)(3) status is approved, and goes directly to program costs.

Payable to: The Elévara Foundation
Mail to: 30 N Gould St Ste N, Sheridan, WY 82801
Note: Include your email for a donation receipt and impact updates

Email or Call

Available Now

Contact us to discuss your donation, arrange a wire transfer for larger gifts, or learn more about our programs. We respond within 24 hours during business days.

Email: foundation@elevarafoundation.org
Phone: (706) 363-0811
Hours: Monday–Friday, 9am–5pm CST
Email About Donating Call (706) 363-0811
